findings.heading: Time series and outbreak detection / Временные ряды и обнаружение вспышек
findings.proposition: The Russian text says the page that uses the campylobacter data is `epidemic_models.ru.qmd`; the English says it is `time_series.qmd`.
findings.reader_consequence: A Russian reader clicking the link is sent to a different chapter than the one the data belong to. `epidemic_models.ru.qmd` sits in `_excluded/` and is not built, so the link resolves to nothing and the reader never reaches the Time series and outbreak detection page (`time_series.ru.qmd`) that actually uses `campylobacter_germany`.

findings.heading: Flexdashboard
findings.proposition: The English states that the flexdashboard files are R Markdown/HTML source files, not example datasets, and therefore are not part of the appliedepidata package, so they must be downloaded directly from Github. The Russian omits this whole statement.
findings.reader_consequence: A Russian reader who has installed appliedepidata will look for the outbreak dashboard files with `get_data()`/`save_data()` or in `list_data()`, find nothing, and conclude the package or their install is broken instead of using the direct Github links.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / Отслеживание контактов
findings.proposition: The English states that the Go.Data contact tracing data is not part of appliedepidata. The Russian omits this clause and only says the data can be downloaded from the links.
findings.reader_consequence: A Russian reader will search appliedepidata for the contact tracing datasets, since the page never says they are outside the package, and will not understand why `list_data()` does not list `cases_clean`, `contacts_clean` or `followups_clean`.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Скачать руководство для работы офлайн
findings.proposition: The Russian bullet list of offline-use considerations carries a fourth bullet instructing the reader to install the appliedepidata R package, which contains all the example data, with installation described below. The English list has three bullets and no such item.
findings.reader_consequence: The Russian reader is told to install a package as part of preparing for offline use, in a list the English reserves for offline-viewing caveats. Nothing is factually wrong, but it is content the English original does not carry at this point.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Скачать руководство для работы офлайн
findings.proposition: The Russian adds a closing instruction, 'Теперь загрузите пакет для использования в текущей сессии R:' (Now load the package for use in the current R session:). The English section ends after the Mac/mobile download note and has no such instruction.
findings.reader_consequence: The sentence ends in a colon and promises a step, but no code chunk or further text follows it before the next heading. The Russian reader looks for a package-loading command that does not exist and may believe the page is truncated or that a required step is missing.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / Отслеживание контактов
findings.proposition: The English NOTE invites the reader to contribute alternative sample data or content for the page. The Russian NOTE says instead that the reader should contact the team if they want to use alternative data or materials for this page.
findings.reader_consequence: The Russian reader reads a solicitation for contributions as an offer of support, so a reader who has alternative Go.Data-style sample data does not realise the handbook team is asking for it, and a reader wanting to use other data may write in expecting help that is not on offer.

findings.heading: Case linelist / Построчный список случаев
findings.proposition: The Russian adds the claim that using the .rds linelist means only minimal cleaning is needed after importing the data into R ('Это позволит вам выполнить лишь минимальную вычистку после импорта данных в R'). The English case linelist section says only that the .rds file is R-specific and preserves column classes.
findings.reader_consequence: The extra sentence sets an expectation about how much cleaning the clean linelist still needs, which the English does not make in this section. In English that claim is attached to the malaria count data only, so the Russian reader generalises a statement the original scopes elsewhere.
